Faraate bharte hue tez-raftaar ghodon ki qasam
Jo taap maar kar chingaariyaan udaane waale hain
Phir subah-dam hamla karne waale hain
Aur dushman ki jamiyat mein dar aane waale hain
Be-shak insaan apne Parwardigar ke liye bada nashukra hai
Aur woh khud bhi is baat ka gawaah hai
Aur woh maal ki mohabbat mein bahut sakht hai
Kya use nahin maaloom hai ke jab murdon ko qabron se nikaala jaaega
Aur dil ke raazon ko zaahir kar diya jaaega
To un ka Parwardigar us din ke haalaat se khoob ba-khabar hoga
